notes: Strip c: x 3530-4920 plus ~300 px overlap (3230-5220). Main N-S streets: Highland Avenue (x~3618-3635, Goodman to McMillan), Burnet Avenue (x~4233-4245), Durbin Place, Vernon Place, Harvey Avenue (x~5121-5140). Bethesda Avenue runs along the top edge west of Burnet (north side = plate edge) and comes in on a SE diagonal; Ridgeway Avenue starts at Burnet ~45 px further south. Harvey Avenue turns into Vernon Place through a reverse curve at y 2820-2990 (no name boundary printed; curve bends split between the two names at the middle of the east-west leg). Names: Union printed without suffix (recorded as Union Street); Dolores Alley and Holcroft Alley read as names split across two blocks (DOLORES/ALLEY, HOLCROFT/ALLEY). East Rochelle Street and East University Avenue names read from labels west of the strip. Reading Road printed READING (suffix assumed). McMillan printed E. McMILLAN (recorded East McMillan Street). Large spaced lettering (MILLER, CARPENTER, DONAHUE, VERNON, KINSEY'S, W.M. BURNET'S, KEMPER H., THOS. McGECHIN'S) are owner names, not streets. Melish jogs ~60 px south across Harvey (two T's). Edmunds Street / Linton crossing lies east of x 5300, outside the overlap. Alley at y~6458 (east of Highland, 20 ft) runs through Jos. Kinsey's lot to Burnet; alley at y~6518 west of Highland continues west beyond x 3230.
